articles.description: The following articles are the most accessed digital object identifier (DOI) manuscripts for Spectroscopy and LCGC International during the month of October 2026. Nine articles are individually ranked here by DOI page views; the seventh-highest entry (99 views) was recorded against the bare LCGC North America journal-level DOI rather than an individual article and is therefore not attributable to a single manuscript.

articles.title: New X-Ray Method Maps How Spinal Disc Collagen Carries Loads Across Scales
articles.description: Researchers developed TomoSAXS, a multimodal X-ray imaging method that links tissue-level deformation with fiber and fibril mechanics in intact intervertebral discs. Applied to loaded rat discs and a static human disc specimen, the method mapped relationships among collagen pre-strain, fiber curvature, and local mechanical response across multiple length scales.
